name: Webex Calling
description: Webex Calling is Cisco's cloud business phone system for PSTN calling, number management, locations, routing, queues, auto attendants, voicemail, devices, and telephony administration.
agentUseSummary: Connect an eligible Webex administrator through Relay-owned PKCE OAuth with one read-only telephony configuration scope, then inspect one bounded page of masked number state and type metadata.

capabilities.label: Read masked number inventory
capabilities.description: Inspect bounded Webex Calling number state and type without owner, location, routing, or full-number data.

approvalRequired.label: List masked calling numbers
approvalRequired.description: List one bounded page of masked Webex Calling number-inventory metadata.

blocked.label: Private identity and location
blocked.description: Full phone numbers, full extensions, routing prefixes, enterprise significant numbers, owner IDs and names, location IDs and names, mobile networks, routing profiles, and raw records are not returned.

blocked.label: Calling configuration changes
blocked.description: Number assignment, activation, porting, location, routing, trunks, plans, queues, auto attendants, voicemail, emergency settings, policies, and all other configuration writes are not exposed.

blocked.label: Calls and communications content
blocked.description: Active calls, call history, CDRs, participants, voicemail, recordings, transcripts, messages, contacts, dialing, answering, transfer, redirect, media, and tones are not exposed.

blocked.label: Raw Webex API access
blocked.description: Arbitrary paths, filters, cursors, origins, headers, bodies, access tokens, pagination, bulk export, and adjacent Webex products are not exposed.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Every organization-wide masked number-inventory read requires matching Relay approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: Selected masked inventory reads run without Relay per-action approval while fixed Webex origins, endpoint, bounds, masking, audits, OAuth scope, admin role, licensing, and provider limits remain enforced.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts one approval-aware masked Webex Calling inventory tool and refreshes the OAuth grant server-side.
Railway mounts one approval-aware masked Webex Calling inventory tool and refreshes the OAuth grant server-side.

providerSetup.blocker: Relay must register and verify a Webex Integration with the exact spark-admin:telephony_config_read scope; an eligible Webex administrator in a Calling-enabled organization must then authorize it.
providerSetup.nextAction: Configure the exact Railway callback and encrypted client secret, complete provider/app review if required, authorize with an eligible administrator, exercise Safe denial/approval and Dangerous reads, verify refresh/disconnect, deploy through the integration lane, and run live acceptance.

evidence.supports: Webex documents organization number reads and requires a full or read-only administrator token with spark-admin:telephony_config_read; Relay uses only the fixed list endpoint and masks its private fields.
Webex documents authorization-code token exchange, rotating refresh tokens, admin-only scope behavior, and the telephony configuration read scope.
Webex identifies spark-admin:telephony_config_read as the read-only organization Calling configuration scope and separates it from call control and CDR scopes.
